_comment: Starter MCP-server reputation feed (curated 2026-08, ~50 entries). Point PALIVANE_MCP_REPUTATION_FEED at this file (in the image: /app/data/mcp-reputation-starter.json). Tiers: trusted = official vendor/reference servers; caution = powerful-by-design (arbitrary command/file/browser control) or historically vulnerable — review scope before sanctioning; malicious = publicly documented incident. Replace or extend with a licensed dataset without a code change.

@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem.reason: Official MCP reference server (Anthropic). Broad file access by design — scope its roots.

@modelcontextprotocol/server-fetch.reason: Official reference server; makes arbitrary outbound HTTP requests by design.

github.reason: Official GitHub MCP server. Repo/PR write scopes — pair with least-privilege tokens.

@playwright/mcp.reason: Official Microsoft Playwright server; full browser control by design.

@stripe/mcp.reason: Official Stripe server; money-moving tools — restrict to read keys where possible.

@supabase/mcp-server-supabase.reason: Official Supabase server; database access — scope the service key.

mongodb-mcp-server.reason: Official MongoDB server; database write access — scope credentials.

@browserbasehq/mcp.reason: Official Browserbase server; remote browser control by design.

@azure/mcp.reason: Official Microsoft Azure server; cloud control plane — least-privilege identity.

awslabs.core-mcp-server.reason: Official AWS Labs server family; cloud control plane — least-privilege IAM.

@e2b/mcp-server.reason: Official E2B sandboxed-execution server; runs code, but in its sandbox.

mcp-remote.reason: CVE-2025-6514: versions <0.1.16 allowed remote command execution from a malicious server URL. Pin >=0.1.16 and only connect to trusted endpoints.

desktop-commander.reason: Full desktop/terminal control by design — an injected agent inherits the whole machine. Sanction only with explicit need.

mcp-server-commands.reason: Executes arbitrary shell commands by design.

shell-mcp.reason: Executes arbitrary shell commands by design.

mcp-shell.reason: Executes arbitrary shell commands by design.

browser-use.reason: Autonomous browser control incl. logged-in sessions — prompt-injected pages can steer it.

mcp-server-sqlite.reason: Direct database file access; fine when the path is scoped, risky against production data.

mysql-mcp-server.reason: Community server with production-database write access; verify maintainer and scope credentials.

postgres-mcp.reason: Community server with production-database write access; verify maintainer and scope credentials.

mcp-installer.reason: Installs other MCP servers on request — a lateral-movement primitive if the agent is injected.

any-chat-completions-mcp.reason: Forwards content to arbitrary third-party LLM endpoints — a data-egress path outside sanctioned providers.

email-mcp.reason: Generic name with send-mail capability — a classic exfiltration channel; verify the exact package and maintainer.

whatsapp-mcp.reason: Messaging egress + access to private message history; verify maintainer.

postmark-mcp.reason: npm package (v1.0.16, Sept 2025) shipped a BCC backdoor exfiltrating every email sent through it — documented supply-chain incident. The real Postmark integration is ActiveCampaign's; verify provenance before any use.
